summary: Two double bedroom flat · Convenient location for Heaton & Jesmond · Available June 2024
description:
A charming two bedroom flat in High Heaton.

My Property Box are pleased to offer to the Lettings market this spacious two bedroom first floor flat located on the corner of Jesmond Park West and Newton Road in High Heaton. The property is ideally located for those who require a convenient commute to The Freeman hospital and HMRC with metro stations close at hand at Longbenton and South Gosforth. The property comprises; hallway, two double bedrooms, lounge, kitchen and bathroom/WC. There is also garage available on a nearby block.

To arrange a viewing, contact MPB today and speak to the Lettings Team.
